title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
description: Interactive Power BI report for chocolate sales leadership covering revenue, profit, shipment efficiency, geography, products, and salesperson performance.
metric: $34M+ Sales Analysed with 60.3% Profit Margin, 6,113 Shipments Across 6 Countries, Built 30+ DAX Measures with Time-Intelligence Analytics
insights: Regional analysis revealed APAC as the dominant revenue contributor, helping identify high-performing business markets.
Found that regions with fewer shipments still maintained higher profit margins through optimized operational performance..
Found balanced geography performance, with only a $400K gap between the highest and lowest country sales.
